source_anomaly_disclosure: FOUR source quirks preserved verbatim, each proven by arithmetic or coordinates: (1) row 164-994C-5H-4 (38.90 m, -183/-80.6) appears TWICE as a VERBATIM full duplicate - the archive's only exact repeated row; (2) three further replicate pairs at identical label+depth with differing values (996D-1H: deltaD -136 vs -175; 997A-13H-7: -166 vs -196; 997B-47X-4: -201 vs -192) - real analytical replicates carried as rows; (3) TWO provable depth corruptions: 994C-25X-2 archives 550.30 m between cores at 141 and 244 m (the only core-order inversion in that hole), and 997A-28X-2 archives 386.90 m - out of core order AND equal to 997A-48X-2's depth to the centimetre, a copy-paste artifact in the source; (4) the event headers label holes 997A/B 'Nicaraguan Rise, North Atlantic Ocean' while their own coordinates (31.843 N, 75.469 W) sit on the BLAKE RIDGE off the Carolinas, ~2,000 km from the Nicaraguan Rise - an event-metadata error refuted by the file's own numbers
purpose: forty-fourth catalogue entry - the BLAKE RIDGE / US ATLANTIC MARGIN joins as region THIRTY-TWO (the birthplace of marine gas-hydrate science) and natural-gas dual-isotope geochemistry is kind THIRTY-THREE, completing the catalogue's petroleum-fluids triad: Hydrate Ridge measured WHERE the gas is locked (entry 34), Woodlark screened WHAT the source rock could make (entry 43), and Blake Ridge fingerprints WHERE THE GAS CAME FROM - and the verdict is re-derived on every gate run: ALL 37 delta13C values sit below -50 permil (range -82.4 to -59.7), squarely in the microbial CO2-reduction field of the genetic diagram with ZERO thermogenic contribution - the world's type hydrate province is charged entirely by biology, including all four isotope-measured hydrate-bound samples (-65.8 to -70.7)
verified: 42 rows / 126 counted cells against the header's own Size declaration (EXACT under the measured label-counting convention); delta13C in [-82.4, -59.7] with all values < -50 (microbial); deltaD in [-256, -136]; the verbatim full-duplicate row + three replicate pairs pinned; both depth corruptions pinned (one inversion per affected hole, 28X-2 = 48X-2 depth equality); the Nicaraguan Rise mislabel pinned beside its refuting coordinates; five hydrate-sample comments pinned; gate-pinned; source URL serves the identical dataset
